messages:
samantha.sales: OrionBank POC just reported failures during the SSO warmup and auth-heavy test ramp. They see intermittent 502/503 for the generate endpoint and bursts of 429s when the auth microservice polls tokens. They asked for a war-room.
theo.se: joining. can you share the exact error text and the flow (SSO -> token-exchange -> generate)?
samantha.sales: yes from the thread: 
```
2026-03-21T14:02:31Z WARN request_id=ozkA1 model=rw-large status=502 upstream=nginx_error msg="bad gateway to backend"
2026-03-21T14:02:33Z ERROR request_id=ozkA2 model=rw-large status=503 backend=kernel_timeout detail="kernel hung on kv sync"
2026-03-21T14:02:35Z INFO request_id=ozkA3 model=rw-large status=429 reason=org_rate_limit org=ob-orion limit=600/min
2026-03-21T14:02:36Z ERROR authsvc request_id=auth-789 status=401 msg="invalid_client" href="/oauth/token"
```
They run a token-exchange loop right after SSO redirect. cURL of their token exchange: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://auth.orion.example/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=ORION-PROD&client_secret=xxxx'
```
anika.eng: looks like cascading failures: auth svc 401 -> retries -> many quick attempts to our generate endpoint with bad tokens -> our ingress returns 429 for org limit and some upstream 502s as nginx hits backend pool flaps. do they use streaming?
samantha.sales: yes, streaming enabled. they have a front-end that tries to stream partial summaries and on failed token renewals it replays.
evan.sre: pulling quota and ingress metrics. @quota-bot can you pull org lw? (org id ob-orion)
quota-bot: Quota snapshot for org ob-orion between 2026-03-21T14:00 and 14:10: org_limit=600/min, observed_peak=1240/min, protective_rate_limiter_engaged=true, ingress_queue_peak=2.8k
evan.sre: that confirms overrun. also seeing backend worker pool error rate jump correlated with ingress spike. some workers report kernel GC pauses and a few OOMs.
anika.eng: kernel GC + OOMs exacerbated by many short-lived streaming sessions which keep KV handles alive. immediate suggestions: 1) ask client to pause automatic retries on 401s and implement exponential backoff, 2) warmup with single-shot non-streaming calls (max_tokens=256) instead of many concurrent streams, 3) temporarily reduce client concurrency to <= 40, 4) we can apply a temporary org burst increase for 60m if sales signs off.
samantha.sales: client wants an immediate quota bump for 2 hours. they need to finish compliance demo at 16:00 local. can we do 2 hours?
evan.sre: can do 60m quickly; 2h needs manager sign-off. I'll request. @claire.ps can you confirm we can offer a 2-hour dev-reserve as a one-off?
claire.ps: can approve a 2-hour dev-reserve for POC under a signed letter. Sales to capture PO or email confirmation. Finance will triage billing later.
evan.sre: applied temporary 60m bump first to stop immediate 429s. watch for residual 502/503s.
samantha.sales: after bump they retried and got fewer 429s but still 502 spikes ~14:07. logs show a backend worker restarted (worker-12).
anika.eng: worker restart implies we hit a process-level crash likely due to heavy simultaneous KV syncs. mitigation now: route org to rw-medium-4k for next 45 mins while we debug memory growth on rw-large. i'll open ENG ticket.
evan.sre: applying route fallback to rw-medium-4k now.
quota-bot: Action: temporary_quota_bump applied to org ob-orion for 60 minutes by evan.sre at 2026-03-21T14:05Z
quota-bot: Action: routing_override applied for org ob-orion -> rw-medium-4k for 45 minutes by evan.sre at 2026-03-21T14:08Z
samantha.sales: client accepted fallback; they request a written mitigation plan and a post-call runbook for SSO warmup. also asked for Dedicated trial pricing for a weekend soak.
anika.eng: I'll document a warmup recipe: prefix-only warmup, non-streaming, max_tokens=256, 30s spacing between sessions, capped concurrency, and token-exchange backoff guidance. Opening ENG-SEC-6621 to track kernel memory accounting and crash reproduction.
evan.sre: I'll open SRE-OPS-7783 to investigate worker restarts and define alert thresholds to preemptively protect customers.
claire.ps: Sales action: capture written confirmation for 2-hour dev-reserve and PO for Dedicated trial. Finance to follow.
samantha.sales: i'll send the recap + next steps to Orion. Thanks team. let's reconvene if alerts reappear. :thumbsup:
